mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_no, o.customer_name, o.customer_phone, o.order_date, o.final_amount, o.status, o.payment_status, o.shipping_method, o.tracking_number, COUNT(oi.item_id) as item_count, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_quantity, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT oi.product_category) as product_categories, GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT(oi.product_name, '(', oi.quantity, ')') ORDER BY oi.item_id ASC SEPARATOR '; ' ) as product_summary, CASE WHEN o.status = 'DELIVERED' THEN DATEDIFF(o.updated_time, o.order_date) ELSE DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), o.order_date) END as days_since_order, customer_stats.total_orders as customer_total_orders, customer_stats.total_consumption as customer_total_consumption FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_phone, COUNT(*) as total_orders, SUM(final_amount) as total_consumption FROM orders GROUP BY customer_phone) customer_stats ON o.customer_phone = customer_stats.customer_phone WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_no, o.customer_name, o.customer_phone, o.order_date, o.final_amount, o.status, o.payment_status, o.shipping_method, o.tracking_number, customer_stats.total_orders, customer_stats.total_consumption
